asked.item: Why the follow gate was skipped
Test account never gets the follow question
Published November 12, passed gate last week on same account

verdict.reason: The pages say that on automations published after November 10, 2026, a contact confirmed as a follower within 30 days skips the follow gate, which matches the log.

steps.text: On automations published after November 10, 2026, a contact Blotato confirmed as a follower within the last 30 days skips the follow gate.
When the gate is skipped, there is no gate message and no check, and your message sends right away.
Your test contact passed a follow gate on the same connected account in an earlier run, so Blotato sends your message without asking again.
To see the gate message while testing, comment or message from an account that has not passed a follow gate in the last 30 days.
